sentences.text:
Section 302 Of The Indian Penal Code vs In Re : Somita Ghosh
on 6 May, 2025

Author: Suvra Ghosh Bench: Suvra Ghosh 06.05.2025 jb.
jdt.
C.R.M. (DB) 928 of 2025 In Re : An Application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure/under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with Naihati Police Station Case No. 59/24 dated 24/2/2024 under Sections 498A/326/307/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code and added Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code.
And In Re : Somita Ghosh Mr. Soewel Bhattacharjee ... For the Petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner does not intend to press the application.
In view of the above, the application is dismissed for non- prosecution.
Urgent certified website copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance with all requisite formalities.
